accounting.request: charge complete original request transport before buffering; preserve original bytes
accounting.artifacts: charge every actual decoded occurrence, including repeated references; simultaneous retained originals and output count toward peak
accounting.trees: count every object/array/scalar occurrence, root depth zero; shared references do not remove serialized occurrence charges
accounting.composition: charge all original tree scans, guarded edits, per-statement exports, complete reimport/reexport and full source comparisons; never treat statement count as actual work
accounting.output: charge full serialized candidate including base64 artifacts, joins, source paths/pins, coverage, obligations and qualification; SQL byte length alone is insufficient
accounting.work: one unit per visited tree occurrence plus every compared, hashed, copied, encoded or decoded byte; repeated owner calls charge each occurrence and actual additional work
accounting.containment: backend execution requires a registered isolated runtime accounting/cancellation profile; stop public waiting cannot release active work capacity
accounting.failure: no SQL or partial statement inventory on refusal; diagnostics obey independent bounded totals

scope: Pure generation using existing pinned UMF APIs and Truss-owned composition. Native installation/catalog collection and Weft compilation have separate resource profiles; no profile receives an unlimited allowance.
